verdict.rationale: Raygun documents token-authenticated programmatic services that fit CI pipelines: an external access token for the Deployments API and for uploading dSYMs, ProGuard mapping files, and JavaScript source maps via API. It also offers deployment tracking and an official MCP server for headless agent access. However, there is no explicit CI/CD integration guide, CLI, or headless-run documentation, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: dedicated CLI or CI plugins (e.g. GitHub Actions), explicit CI/headless workflow documentation, published API spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
